behavior: New and completed legacy recent generations reconcile all mailbox messages before using history.
Mailbox listing explicitly includes Spam/Trash and retains provider labels.
Incremental messageAdded history omits the label filter.
In-flight v2 continuation pages, original account identity and immutable receipts remain intact.
No cursor advances until all pages of the captured generation settle; lost replies recover without new provider reads.
limitations: Google credential destination approval and real mailbox acceptance remain pending.
Signed-in owner access and new preview browser approval remain pending.
Historical backfill retains its legacy scope; v3 recent reconciliation fills that coverage gap.
Message additions are captured; current label/deletion state is not mirrored. Already purged provider messages cannot be recovered by this change.
Retaining a message does not prove it should contribute to a staff score; draft/spam eligibility and representative scoring acceptance remain required.
